rules.statement: A landlord cannot avoid the operation of the prohibition contained in section 13 (1) (c) of the Rent Restriction Act by a mere statement on oath that the premises are required for the purpose of trade or business. He must place before the Court evidence sufficient to convince it of the truth of his claim.
